subject: RFI: model sourcing, provenance & escrow assurances
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmefin.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmefin.com
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFI - Model sourcing, provenance & escrow assurances

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to respond to our RFI. Attached is the Acme model sourcing worksheet (Acme_RFI_Model-Sourcing.xlsx). For the purposes of our procurement review please provide concise answers to the following items related to models you surface in the Redwood catalog and any OEM/distribution workflows:

- License types for each model (open-source license name and any additional distributor/packaging restrictions).
- Provenance evidence: source code repo commit IDs, weight artifact hashes, tokenizer versions, and any SBOM-like manifests you provide.
- Pinning / version guarantees: ability to pin model (weights + tokenizer + config) and SLA around availability of pinned artifacts.
- Update notification and change control: how customers are notified of model updates, deprecation policies, and rollback paths.
- Escrow or custodied storage: options for escrow of weights and runtime that we can use for continuity / audit (who holds escrow, trigger conditions, access model).
- Any third-party dependencies (pretrained checkpoints, licensed datasets) that affect redistribution or derivative works.

Please answer in the matrix where possible and include supporting evidence files (hash lists, provenance report). We are on a tight schedule and would like an initial response within 2 business days; let us know if that timeline is feasible.

Regards,
Dr. Elena Soto
Director, Vendor Risk & Procurement
Acme Financial Services

Attachment: Acme_RFI_Model-Sourcing.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmefin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI - Model sourcing, provenance & escrow assurances

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list and the worksheet. We can meet your 2-business-day timeline for an initial, consolidated response. Planned deliverables in the initial package:

- redwood_model_licensing_matrix_v1.xlsx — per-model license assertions and downstream redistribution notes.
- model_provenance_report_20270615.pdf — hashes, repo commits, build manifest summary for models we currently serve.
- escrow_terms_summary_20270615.docx — options we offer (third-party escrow, customer-custodied snapshot, emergency access terms).

A few quick clarifying Qs so we can tailor the response:
1) Is escrow intended as a mandatory requirement for shortlisted vendors, or would Acme accept a conditional/optional escrow + contractual continuity clause?
2) For provenance evidence, do you need raw training-data manifests (where non-sensitive), or is an SBOM-style artifact listing model components sufficient?

Cc'ing Aditya (Solutions Engineering) and Karthik (Sales) to coordinate the technical pack and the contract-level language. We will upload the package to the Drive link and send the DocuSign-ready escrow summary if you want to proceed.

Deliverable ETA: 2027-06-17 17:00 PT (initial package).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI - model sourcing, provenance & escrow assurances (internal)

Lauren / Karthik —

Draft responses and notes below (I'll assemble the artifacts and hashes by EOD). Please review and flag edits for legal: we should avoid overpromising access to training datasets — provide assertions only where permitted by upstream licenses. Key points to include in the final customer-facing doc:

- License mapping: For each model we list upstream license (e.g., Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY-SA) plus any distribution packaging constraints (e.g., some weights redistributed under a model distributor agreement). We'll attach license text snippets and link to original repo.

- Provenance artifacts: include (a) source repo URL + commit SHA, (b) weights manifest with SHA256 checksums, (c) tokenizer artifact version + tokenizer repo SHA, (d) build pipeline snapshot (container image digest). Where we host the weights, also include storage URI and access controls.

- Pinning and availability: customers can pin model version identifiers (weights+tokenizer+config hash). Redwood will retain pinned artifacts for the duration of the contract plus a 90-day grace period after termination (standard). For enterprise Dedicated/Private customers we can extend retention or arrange escrow.

- Escrow options:
  * Option A — Third-party escrow (recommended): we deposit weights + minimal runtime + verification scripts with a neutral escrow provider; access is triggered by defined legal/operational events.
  * Option B — Customer snapshot + cryptographic attestations: we provide a signed snapshot and key material under customer KMS when requested; restoration support available under SOW.
  * Option C — On-demand export: for Private deployments, customer hosts their own copy; Redwood will provide vetted export tooling.

- Update/change control: RFC-based change notices for catalog models. Customers subscribing to a model receive update notifications T-30 days for non-critical updates; critical security fixes may be rolled out with shorter notice but with a rollback plan. We'll describe canary rollout & pinned fallback in the delivery doc.

I'll prepare: provenance_report (pdf), license_matrix (xlsx), weight_hash_list (txt) and escrow_summary (docx). Once ready I'll upload to Drive and share the link for the customer email.

— Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmefin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI - Model sourcing, provenance & escrow assurances

Dr. Soto —

Thanks again for the worksheet. Attached is our initial package addressing each of your bullets. Highlights below and links to the artifacts are included in the Drive package: https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme/model-catalog-licensing-v1

Summary (high level):
- License assertions: redwood_model_licensing_matrix_v1.xlsx maps each catalog model to the upstream license, any downstream redistribution constraints, and whether Redwood applies additional packaging terms.

- Provenance evidence: model_provenance_report_20270615.pdf contains for each model: source repo + commit SHA, weight artifact SHA256, tokenizer artifact version, and a build manifest with container digest. We do not publish raw training data manifests where restricted by license/privacy, but we include SBOM-style component lists and reproduction scripts where permitted.

- Pinning & retention: Customers can pin specific model-version identifiers (weights+tokenizer+config). For hosted customers we retain pinned artifacts for the contract period + 90 days; for Dedicated/Private customers we can add extended retention or escrow as a contractual term.

- Escrow options: See escrow_terms_summary_20270615.docx. We offer: (A) neutral third-party escrow (weights + minimal runtime + verification scripts), (B) customer-custodied encrypted snapshot with KMS-based key escrow, or (C) Private deployment export with validated tooling. DocuSign link for a sample escrow schedule is included if you'd like to initiate.

- Update notifications & rollback: We provide T-30 change notices for non-critical catalog updates and document rollback playbooks for pinned fallbacks. For customers with stricter SLAs we support canary rollouts and A/B routing to pinned versions.

Attachments included: redwood_model_licensing_matrix_v1.xlsx; model_provenance_report_20270615.pdf; escrow_terms_summary_20270615.docx; weight_hash_list_20270615.txt

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Aditya to go over the provenance report and the escrow mechanics.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
